title: Oracle Fusion Cloud Period Close Accelerator
description: A reusable Excel framework that runs the Oracle Fusion Cloud month-end close end to end: 100+ sequenced tasks across 12 modules, scope automation, a live tracker and a 100+ report reference.
longDescription: The Period Close Accelerator turns the Oracle Fusion Cloud month-end close into a controlled, repeatable routine. A consultant configures it once per client, then the team runs it every period. It maps over 100 sequenced close tasks across the 12 Financials and SCM modules, each with the exact Oracle ESS job or process name and clear recommendations, and rolls progress up into a live Master Close Tracker. Mark a module Out of Scope and its rows grey out across every sheet automatically. It is a plain .xlsx: no macros, native Excel formulas, data validation and conditional formatting only.
whatsInside: Master Close Tracker that rolls up percent complete and status per module from a single status column

Over 100 sequenced close tasks across 12 modules: Procurement & Receipt Accounting, Inventory, Cost Accounting, Cash Management, Receivables, Expenses, Payables, Fixed Assets, Lease Accounting, Intercompany, General Ledger and Budgetary Control
Each task with its exact Oracle ESS job or process name and practical recommendations
Scope automation: set a module In or Out of Scope once and every sheet updates
Period Open tasks plus a Known Issues and dependency-traps sheet
A reference of 100+ standard Oracle reports, tagged by module and purpose
A Custom Reports Register that flows your client reports into the listing automatically
Plain .xlsx, no macros; sheets protected with formulas locked and input cells open

faqs.a: No. It is a plain .xlsx that works in any modern Excel. All automation is native: formulas, data validation and conditional formatting. Nothing to enable, and nothing blocked by security policies.

faqs.q: How does it work across different clients?
faqs.a: It is a configurable template. Set each module In or Out of Scope on the control sheet, adjust the close sequence if needed, and the whole pack adapts. Out-of-scope modules grey out and drop out of the roll-up.

faqs.q: Do I need to be an Oracle expert to use it?
faqs.a: No. Each task names the exact Oracle process to run and explains why, so a finance team can follow it. A consultant can also tailor it once and hand it over.

faqs.q: Can the whole team use it during the close?
faqs.a: Yes. Keep it on SharePoint or OneDrive for shared editing. Standard guidance is locked so it cannot be changed by accident; only the input cells (status, owners, dates, scope) are open.

title: OTBI Analytics Pack for Oracle Fusion
description: Interactive OTBI analyses for Oracle Fusion Financials across GL, AP, AR and FA, built for exploring and reconciling on screen. Portable parameters, ready to run.
longDescription: A set of ready-built OTBI analyses for the reports finance teams pull most across GL, AP, AR and FA. OTBI is the tool for exploring and reconciling on screen: drill into balances, filter by ledger and business unit, and export to Excel. Built on standard subject areas with parameters for ledger and business unit, so they move between instances without rework. If you need formatted, printable statements, pair this with the BI Publisher Report Pack.
whatsInside: GL trial balance and account analysis (OTBI)
AP invoice and ageing analyses
AR transaction and ageing analyses
Fixed Assets cost and depreciation analyses
Parameter setup notes so the analyses are portable across instances

faqs.a: On-screen exploration and reconciliation. You drill into balances, filter by ledger and business unit, and export to Excel. For formatted, printable statements, use the BI Publisher Report Pack, or the bundle that includes both.

faqs.q: Will these work on my instance?
faqs.a: Yes. They are built on standard subject areas with parameters for ledger and business unit, so they move between instances without rework.

title: BI Publisher Report Pack for Oracle Fusion
description: Pixel-perfect BI Publisher templates for Oracle Fusion Financials across GL, AP, AR and FA: formal statements and documents, formatted and ready to run.
longDescription: A set of BI Publisher templates for the formatted, printable output finance and audit teams need: statements, ageing documents and account analyses, laid out cleanly and ready to run. BI Publisher is the tool for pixel-perfect output, where OTBI is for on-screen exploration. Built with portable data models and parameters so they move between instances. If you also want to explore and reconcile on screen, pair this with the OTBI Analytics Pack.
whatsInside: GL account analysis and trial balance templates
AP invoice and ageing report templates
AR transaction and ageing report templates
Fixed Assets cost and depreciation templates
Data model and parameter setup notes for portability across instances

faqs.q: What is BI Publisher best for?
faqs.a: Pixel-perfect, printable output: formal statements and documents you can hand to auditors or leadership. For on-screen exploration and reconciliation, use the OTBI Analytics Pack, or the bundle that includes both.

faqs.q: Will these work on my instance?
faqs.a: Yes. They are built with standard data models and parameters for ledger and business unit, so they are portable across instances.

The complete reporting baseline for Oracle Fusion Financials.

Everything in the BI Publisher Report Pack: formatted statements and documents
Guidance on when to use OTBI versus BI Publisher
Parameter setup notes for portability across instances

faqs.q: Is it cheaper than buying both separately?
faqs.a: Yes. The bundle is priced below the total of the OTBI Analytics Pack and the BI Publisher Report Pack bought on their own.
Consultants, report developers and finance teams who want a complete Oracle Fusion reporting baseline: exploration in OTBI and formal output in BI Publisher, without building either from scratch.
